'''Susk'kinad''' was a desert region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. It was located between the [[Twilight Forest]] and the [[Lhon'kinad]] desert. Susk'kinad was a vast desert plain that also encompassed several rocky canyons and tar pits.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Susk'kinad was one of many designated planetary regions in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
